design.scope: canonical effective cwd + durable session ID
design.host_identity: ToolRunContext.agent and AssembleContext.agent/scope; exact agents.get(id) identity required
design.automatic_observation: Capture at tools/pre-execute with opaque token, consume once at tools/result; no mutable latest-agent global.
design.missing_identity: Tool rejects, prompt empty, auto observation warns/skips; never fallback shared.
design.legacy: context.mode=shared only on explicit host configuration; no automatic old library reads or migration.
design.task: Session-context progress slot and run ID are not a business task ID.

tests.regressions: Three pre-implementation behavioral failures, five new adapter tests and one context acceptance gate test.
tests.compatibility: Legacy fixtures explicitly shared. Full MCP/Skill/curated/raw/P0 host probes supplement scoped three-session checks.

hosts.scope: Actual isolated DSH headless processes, local scripted model, three fresh sessions; no subprocess resumed persisted session and no live profile/user library.

review_findings: Nested 246-character worktree caused spawn cwd ENOENT; two worktree-move attempts denied, new clean short worktree created. No live source moved.
Session facade initially returned functions for symbols.initHooks; real Cordis activation failed. Symbol/then protocol keys now undefined; actual probe passed after fix.
Windows file symlink creation unavailable; directory junction is real tested, database-file lstat rejection is an injected test, not physical file-link certification.
Fingerprint missing legacy src/index.ts fixture rejected before ENOENT handler; optional confined lookup corrected, downstream errors remain fail closed.
limitations: Adapter isolation is not OS confidentiality; privileged host/filesystem tools can read files.
No automatic decision sharing between sessions or fork inheritance, no business task registry/grants.
cwd, not git root, is the project boundary; directory move gets new scope.
Fresh processes were tested with new sessions; true persisted-session resume not tested. Same ID/dir re-registration tested structurally.
Admission capacity is bounded at4096, overflow skips observation; lifecycle/force-kill resilience not completely certified.
Memory extraction/candidate validation, immutable revisions/code anchors, comprehensive redaction and reference-write concurrency deferred.
New default means old shared library is not visible until explicit host-controlled compatibility/migration decision.
Generated bundle wrapper/schema verified by unit tests; session-specific real probes load adapter directly, not the generated wrapper.
next: Review this independent PR before any live adoption; then implement event-to-candidate lifecycle under explicit scope/grants.
acceptance_policy: Session-v1 fingerprint requires seven context checks in addition to MCP/Skill/cache/persistence legacy compatibility; shared-only acceptance cannot package this candidate.
